periods.time: Escape from League imprisonment and Kyushu disaster
periods.label: 大炎与错误的恩宠
periods.species: human / Blazer transformed by Excessive Awakening
periods.occupation: terrorist religious leader; former wartime soldier/prisoner
periods.affiliation: Tendoshu; formerly imprisoned by the International Mage-Knight League

status.current: destroyed when Toka cuts down his storm-remnant; dies recognizing his grace was a delusion born from weakness
status.condition: blind, physically ruined, spirit-like body; after Moroboshi kills his soul he persists only as a fading will in his disaster magic

relationships.toka-todo: Selects Toka as the main recipient of his ordeal, hoping to force her into grace; is ultimately defeated by her rejection of solitary heroism.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Recognizes Moroboshi as a strong young light; is killed in body and soul by Moroboshi's Musou Ittetsu but persists briefly as a remnant.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Admires Kuraudo's fierce assault and nearly accepts him as another possible hero.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Her foundation's identity check exposes him; he had been sheltered at Wakaba House.
relationships.nishikata-hisako: Receives kindness from Wakaba House under her care before turning that kindness into a false trial.

periods.summary: Harima Tendo appears at Wakaba House as a harmless blind old man and helps with volunteer efforts, but League Japan identifies him as Daien, an escaped and extremely dangerous criminal. He is the Tendoshu leader responsible for the old Imperial Hotel massacre and a Desperado who fell into Excessive Awakening. Believing the disaster power that saved him in wartime torture was divine grace, he tries to force promising young Blazers to awaken by inflicting unbearable trials. In Kyushu he devastates Fukuoka with lightning, fire, wind, earthquakes, landslides, and a freezing storm, all while speaking with sincere love. He is first wounded by Moroboshi and Kuraudo, then killed by Moroboshi's soul-devouring spear, but his will remains in the storm. Toka's collective Raikiri erases that remnant, and in his final moments he realizes that he should have relied on people rather than on a godlike delusion.

key_events.summary: Kurogane Itsuki warns Kanata that the old man at Wakaba House is the escaped criminal Daien.
Reveals his identity, Device, Excessive Awakening, and disaster power while trying to make Toka awaken.
His first large-scale attack destroys much of northern Kyushu and forces League knights to explain Desperado phenomena.
Visits Toka's hospital room and announces a freezing storm to force her into further despair.
Faces the first and second arrows; survives Kuraudo's assault until Moroboshi destroys his soul.
His storm-remnant is erased by Toka's grid-amplified Raikiri, ending Daien.
